PeopleContextState.description: Publication state of the cache-local context snapshot.

oneOf.description: No context has been written in this storage generation.
A full snapshot is being assembled in bounded batches.
A complete snapshot is available for ranking.

PeopleContextState.title: ContextState

ContextAction.description: Publication is separate from batching, so incomplete snapshots never look ready.

oneOf.description: Start a full snapshot. Old per-record epochs are ignored after publication.

previousEpoch.description: Compare-and-set predecessor; a delayed begin cannot supersede newer work.

oneOf.description: Apply at most 500 updates. Ready epochs also accept serial incremental patches.

DirectMessageFacts.description:
The one-to-one conversation a command result opens, with its visible name
and viewed-first recency. Group DMs do not occupy this slot.

name.description: Visible conversation label, independent of the contact's private name.

HydrationScope.description:
Scope captured before starting a background request. Guarded hydration never
switches identity or restores a response into a different storage generation.

identity.description: Expected authenticated response identity, not a record identifier.

storageGeneration.description: Durable data generation observed before the network request.

PersonFactPatch.description: One bounded, explicit fact update. The server still owns contact names/membership.

facts.description: Complete replacement of this person's local facts.

PersonFacts.description: Client-owned ranking facts from the existing channels and email-link sources.

lastInteractionMs.description: Legacy user/recipient interaction timestamp, not relationship updated_at.

secondaryInbox.description: Connected secondary inboxes do not appear as recipient/person suggestions.

PeopleContextUpdate.description: A serial producer must start a new epoch after an uncertain write outcome.

epoch.description: Producer snapshot identity; stale patches cannot change a newer snapshot.

identity.description: Expected authenticated response identity, not a record identifier.

storageGeneration.description: Durable data generation observed before the network request.

ReferenceMatchMode.description: How a caller's inferred names resolve; these are not suggestion rankings.

oneOf.description: Match an entire name, address or identity only.
Prefer whole names/addresses/identities, otherwise require a unique first name.
Treat whole and first names equally, as inferred user property values do.

PeopleReferenceRequest.description: Resolve a bounded set of labels without materializing a personal directory.

excludeSecondaryInboxes.description: Recipient/planner pools can omit connected secondary inboxes, using ready local context.

labels.description: Raw input count is capped before deduplication; each label is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

matching.description: Name matching owned by the requesting surface.

PeopleReferenceRequest.title: PeopleReferenceRequest

PeopleReferenceMatch.description: Evidence for one input label, in the same order as the request.

complete.description:
Malformed matching records cannot establish uniqueness. The caller must also
check directory hydration completeness before relying on a single witness.

people.description: At most two distinct witnesses. Two means ambiguous, not a complete candidate list.

PersonReference.description: One authorized cached contact used as matching evidence, not a suggestion catalog.

name.description: The stored private name; absence must not invent a first-name match from an email local part.

userId.description: Canonical target identity, never the viewer-scoped record id.

PeopleReferenceResult.description: Read-only reference resolution never publishes context or changes membership.

oneOf.description: Required secondary-inbox exclusions are not ready.
A bounded result for every requested label.

matches.description: Same length/order as the raw input labels, including duplicates.

policyVersion.description: Matching contract version, shared with person policy capability admission.

PeopleMode.description: Surface-specific priorities applied before limiting results.

oneOf.description: Exact/prefix labels, then deterministic relevance/recency and DM boosts.
Exact addresses, address prefixes, word prefixes, then recipient weights.
Name/email relevance and user interaction recency for mentions.
Property user pickers: personal interaction, domain preference and self pinning.

PeopleSearch.description:
A ranked window over the current cached directory, not a completeness claim.
Continuations pin the ranking clock and context epoch; concurrent row updates
have ordinary keyset semantics, not a transactional snapshot guarantee.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from this same account, generation and search policy.

excluded.description: Explicit exclusions, applied before ranking (for example self).

nowMs.description: Injected wall clock for reproducible scoring.

query.description: Shared subsequence input, capped at 512 UTF-8 bytes.

PeopleSearch.title: PeopleSearch

DirectMessageFacts.description:
The one-to-one conversation a command result opens, with its visible name
and viewed-first recency. Group DMs do not occupy this slot.

name.description: Visible conversation label, independent of the contact's private name.

PersonHit.description: Fully materialized winning person; neither the cache key nor DM id replaces user_id.

lastInteractionMs.description: User interaction timestamp for non-command surfaces.

matchRank.description: Priority tier; larger ranks precede smaller ones.

name.description: Visible resolved contact name, with local-part email fallback.

score.description: Corpus-independent blended score within a priority tier.

PeopleSearchResult.description: Local search can be temporarily unavailable without asserting an empty directory.

oneOf.description: No complete local ranking-context snapshot is published.
Bounded ranked results from the cache snapshot.

nextCursor.description:
Continue after this ranked window. A window may be short when prior
conversation duplicates were skipped; only null proves exhaustion.

policyVersion.description:
Menu-policy contract version; older native binaries may not apply
current matching, exclusions and ranking before their result limit.
